Railways Announce Special Trains and Crowd Control for Festive Rush

Indian Railways has announced special trains and crowd control measures to manage the anticipated passenger surge during the upcoming festive season. The Amritsar-Nanded route will see special trains, with details on timings and stops released. Additionally, the Northeast Frontier Railway has extended three existing special trains to accommodate the increased demand. Authorities at Sealdah station are implementing specific crowd management plans in anticipation of the rush.
